commands.text: You are at your local community center. Just in front of it is a notice board.
Every time you've been here, you passed it, paying it no mind. But this time, your eyes are drawn to a peculiar piece of paper.

commands.speaker: Paper on the notice board
commands.text: Once upon a time, a hobby programmer finaly started working on his goal of making an awesome game engine.

commands.speaker: Paper on the notice board
commands.text: A few weeks of hard work later, the results speak for themselves.

commands.speaker: Paper on the notice board
commands.text: This is said game engine, made for Sailfish OS. VNgine, a simple game engine for making visual novels.
This is quite the piece of information. A thought enters your mind.

commands.speaker: Player
commands.text: NO WAY! IT CAN'T BE!

commands.speaker: Player
commands.text: I am inside a game? And not even a good game? Just a sample game, to show off what the engine can do?

commands.speaker: Player
commands.text: No, no, no. That can't be true. Right? Oh my... This can't be happening to me.
You look at the notice board again. You look at your surroundings. You notice some assets are made with a lot of love. Others are clearly AI generated.

commands.speaker: Player
commands.text: How did I not see the AI generated content? I should have noticed sooner.

commands.speaker: Player
commands.text: All right. Just keep calm. I can fix this. Yes. I'll just have to have faith in myself. I can escape this. I'll pay good notice of everything around me. I'll learn about this gameworld. And when I understand everything, I'll be able to escape.

commands.speaker: Liisa
commands.text: %player_title%? Are you okay?

commands.speaker: Liisa
commands.text: You look like you've seen a ghost.

commands.speaker: Player
commands.text: %player_title%?

commands.speaker: Liisa
commands.text: You know I'm calling you that, because that's what you put into the textfields in the settings, right?

commands.speaker: Liisa
commands.text: Let's see what else is in the settings...

commands.speaker: Liisa
commands.text: Poor guy, you don't seem to have much money. Just %starting_wealth% coins?

commands.speaker: Liisa
commands.text: %starting_wealth% coins, huh? I guess that's avarage.

commands.speaker: Liisa
commands.text: %starting_wealth%? coins??? That's a lot!

commands.speaker: Liisa
commands.text: Okay, what more?

commands.speaker: Liisa
commands.text: *Mumbles* Arachnofobia...

commands.speaker: Liisa
commands.text: Not scared of spiders? I whish I was that brave.

commands.speaker: Liisa
commands.text: Scared of spiders. Yeah, who wouldn't?
Liisa looks to be reading on.
Then her face turns red and angry.

commands.speaker: Liisa
commands.text: Adult content? What kind of girl do you think I am? I'll tell you what %player_title%, you go into the settings right now, and change that!

commands.speaker: Liisa
commands.text: Go on. I'll wait...

commands.speaker: Liisa
commands.text: That's better!

commands.speaker: Liisa
commands.text: Smut is turned off. Good. I don't like smut.

commands.speaker: Player
commands.text: Hey, well executed nudity can be tasteful. Not all adult content is smut.

commands.speaker: Liisa
commands.text: Oh yeah? Name one visual novel example...

commands.speaker: Liisa
commands.text: Thought so.

commands.speaker: Player
commands.text: Okay, but this is real life. It isn't a visual novel. Right? Right?

commands.speaker: Liisa
commands.text: Of course it is. We are inside a game.

commands.speaker: Player
commands.text: Well, if would have been a game, I am sure it would have looked a bit better.

commands.speaker: Liisa
commands.text: Like this, %player_title%?

commands.speaker: Player
commands.text: AAAARGH!.

commands.speaker: Liisa
commands.text: Calm down, %player_title%

commands.speaker: Player
commands.text: AAAARGH!.

commands.speaker: Liisa
commands.text: Don't worry, it is not real. It is just to snow the conditional choice system.

commands.speaker: Liisa
commands.text: As your panic will start to reduce, another option will reveal itself. Have patience.

commands.speaker: Liisa
commands.text: Good, you seem to have calmed down a litte.
